text: 建设银行行长张毅8月28日在该行2026年中期业绩发布会上表示，展望下半年，对中国经济长期向好的基本面充满信心，但也清醒认识到经营发展仍面临问题和挑战，建设银行将保持战略定力。他提到，将全力支持扩大内需、产业升级和民营小微企业成长，增强跨境综合服务能力，紧跟国家提振消费政策导向，提升按揭覆盖度和服务水平，深入参与重大促消费活动，并深化普惠民生金融服务。（上证报）
text_en: Zhang Yi, president of China Construction Bank, said on August 28 at the bank's 2026 interim results conference that looking to the second half, the bank is confident in China's long-term economic fundamentals but is also clearly aware of challenges ahead and will maintain strategic focus. He mentioned full support for expanding domestic demand, industrial upgrading, and the growth of private and small-micro enterprises, enhancing cross-border integrated service capabilities, closely following national consumption-boosting policies, improving mortgage coverage and service levels, deeply participating in major consumption-promotion activities, and deepening inclusive livelihood financial services. (Shanghai Securities News)
